options.label: List subscriptions
options.description: Get a paginated list of all subscriptions with filtering options

options.label: Get subscription
options.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific subscription

options.label: Update subscription
options.description: Modify subscription details such as items, billing period, or payment method

options.label: Preview an update to a subscription
options.description: Preview changes before updating a subscription

options.label: Preview a one-time charge for a subscription
options.description: Preview a one-time charge before applying it

options.label: Create a one-time charge for a subscription
options.description: Add a one-time charge to an existing subscription

options.label: Activate a trialing subscription
options.description: Activate a subscription that is currently in trial period

options.label: Cancel a subscription
options.description: Cancel an active subscription immediately or at period end
